name: flightstats_flight_status
description: Status of flight AA100 on a date — gate, delay, baggage. Returns operational status (scheduled vs estimated departure/arrival, gate, terminal, baggage claim) for one specific flight identified by carrier IATA code + flight number + date. Example: flightstats_flight_status({ carrier: "AA", flight: "100", year: 2026, month: 7, day: 2, _apiKey: "appId:appKey" })

_apiKey.description: FlightStats/Cirium credentials as "appId:appKey" (developer.cirium.com; free eval = 20,000 lifetime calls)

name: flightstats_airport_status
description: Departures/arrivals at an airport — a live board of flights leaving from or arriving at an airport on a given date/hour. Example: flightstats_airport_status({ airport: "JFK", type: "dep", year: 2026, month: 7, day: 2, hour: 14, _apiKey: "appId:appKey" })

type.description: Board type: "dep" for departures (default), "arr" for arrivals

_apiKey.description: FlightStats/Cirium credentials as "appId:appKey" (developer.cirium.com; free eval = 20,000 lifetime calls)

name: flightstats_schedule
description: Scheduled flight timetable — the published schedule (departure/arrival airports and times) for a carrier + flight number departing on a date, regardless of live operational status. Example: flightstats_schedule({ carrier: "AA", flight: "100", year: 2026, month: 7, day: 2, _apiKey: "appId:appKey" })

_apiKey.description: FlightStats/Cirium credentials as "appId:appKey" (developer.cirium.com; free eval = 20,000 lifetime calls)
